title: IIoT Controller Demo Kit
explanation: Developed an IIoT controller demo kit with a local mobile application enabling real-time relay ON/OFF control, synchronized operation between mobile app, and display for live status monitoring.

title: Production OEE Monitoring System
explanation: Developed a production OEE monitoring solution to track machine runtime, downtime, and performance metrics, enabling data-driven productivity improvements.

title: Integrated Optical Inspection & Packing Automation Line
explanation: Designed and implemented a complete automated production line integrating part feeding, high-speed optical inspection, defect sorting, and automated packing. The system includes PLC-HMI control, vision processing software, and production data logging to improve inspection accuracy, reduce manual handling, and increase overall throughput.

title: Industrial Wireless Communication System
explanation: Implemented a long-range industrial wireless communication system enabling reliable data transmission between machines and control systems across the plant, supporting stable wireless connectivity up to 1 km in industrial environments.

title: Industrial Tank Level Monitoring System
explanation: Developed an automated tank level monitoring system using industrial sensors and PLC integration to provide real-time level indication, alarms, and data logging.

title: RFID-Based Fluid Dispenser System(Fuel)
explanation: Implemented an RFID-enabled fluid dispensing system to ensure controlled dispensing, user authentication, and accurate consumption tracking.

title: Vision-Based Product Inspection System
explanation: Designed and deployed a vision-based inspection system for automated defect detection, dimensional verification, and quality assurance on production lines.

title: PLC–SCADA Application
explanation: Engineered a PLC–SCADA based application for real-time process monitoring, control, alarm management, and historical data logging.
